entries: Added terminal status reporting over OSC 7501: in terminals that support it, the tab or window shows whether the CLI is working, waiting for your input, done, or failed. The CLI checks for support first, so other terminals are unaffected. Set `AGY_CLI_OSC7501=off` to turn it off, `AGY_CLI_OSC7501=on` for a terminal that supports it but doesn't answer the check, or `AGY_CLI_OSC7501_MESSAGES=brief` to show only the status without details such as the pending command or question.

Added the `alt+m` shortcut (`Option+m` on macOS when Option is set to act as Alt) to send a message using the opposite of your `Queued Messages` setting in `/config`, so you can send right away while in `Queue` mode, or queue a message while in `Send Immediately` mode.

Improved `agy plugin validate` so it checks a plugin with the same rules the CLI uses to load it, instead of simplified checks that rejected valid plugins (such as a manifest without a `name`) and missed problems that kept a plugin from loading. It lists each error and warning with its file and line, accepts a plugin directory or its `plugin.json`, warns about common `plugin.json` mistakes such as unknown fields (with "did you mean" suggestions), invalid names, and components placed inside `.antigravity-plugin/` instead of the plugin root, and adds `--strict` to fail on warnings and `--json` for a machine-readable report in CI.

Fixed the CLI refusing every message with `Eligibility check failed` until you restarted it when the service was briefly unavailable or rate-limited at launch; the check now retries temporary errors and no longer locks the session.

Fixed plugin MCP servers that use a variable in a request header, such as `"Authorization": "Bearer ${TOKEN}"`, sending the literal placeholder and failing to authenticate; headers now get the value you configured, like the server's command, arguments, and environment already did.

Fixed the `/diff` Commit Tree view: the header now counts commits instead of lines, the cursor stops only on commit rows and `Enter` opens that commit, the view fills the terminal height, and it shows the latest 100 commits (previously 10) with scrolling.

Fixed the agent losing track of its file changes, tasks, and session cost when a background command finished while the agent kept working; they no longer roll back to the point where that command started.
Fixed a background command's final output sometimes missing from its task log; the output is now always recorded when the command finishes or is canceled.
Fixed links to directories disappearing from agent responses; they now show the directory name, for example `pipelines/`.

title.zh-TW: 分頁標題即時回報進度，不用切回終端機看狀態
title.en: Tab titles report progress in real time without switching back to the terminal

body.zh-TW:
把終端機縮到背景讓耗時任務自己跑時，我們往往得三不五時切回視窗，確認它到底跑完了沒。⟦走在辦公大樓看電梯燈號，以前得特地走到門前貼著聽聲音才確定動了沒，現在瞄一眼門楣就知道它正在移動、抵達還是卡住。⟧只要你使用的終端機支援 OSC 7501 協定，視窗或分頁標籤就會直接顯示 CLI 正在運作、等待輸入、已完成還是失敗。程式啟動時會先自動偵測終端機是否支援，不支援的軟體不會受到任何干擾。如果想微調顯示方式，可以透過環境變數管理：

```bash
AGY_CLI_OSC7501=off # 關閉狀態回報
AGY_CLI_OSC7501=on # 在支援卻未主動回應偵測的終端機上強制開啟
AGY_CLI_OSC7501_MESSAGES=brief # 只顯示狀態，不顯示等待執行的指令或問題細節
```
body.en:
When minimizing a terminal to run a long-running task in the background, we often have to switch windows repeatedly just to check if it is finished. ⟦Picture glancing at an elevator indicator in an office building: you once had to walk up to the door and listen closely to confirm movement, but now a glance above the door reveals whether it is running, arriving, or stuck.⟧ As long as your terminal supports the OSC 7501 protocol, window or tab titles will directly display whether the CLI is working, waiting for input, completed, or failed. The CLI automatically detects terminal support on startup, so unsupported software remains completely unaffected. If you want to tweak how details are shown, you can manage it with environment variables:

```bash
AGY_CLI_OSC7501=off # Disable status reporting
AGY_CLI_OSC7501=on # Force enable on terminals that support it but do not actively respond to detection
AGY_CLI_OSC7501_MESSAGES=brief # Show only the status, omitting pending commands or prompt details
```

items.original: Added terminal status reporting over OSC 7501: in terminals that support it, the tab or window shows whether the CLI is working, waiting for your input, done, or failed. The CLI checks for support first, so other terminals are unaffected. Set `AGY_CLI_OSC7501=off` to turn it off, `AGY_CLI_OSC7501=on` for a terminal that supports it but doesn't answer the check, or `AGY_CLI_OSC7501_MESSAGES=brief` to show only the status without details such as the pending command or question.

title.zh-TW: 快捷鍵反轉送出模式，臨時插單或排隊免改設定
title.en: Shortcut inverts send mode to bypass queues or jump ahead without changing settings

body.zh-TW: 打好一段訊息準備送出時，如果目前的發送模式正好與當下需求相反，過去總得大費周章進設定選單切換。⟦跟操作辦公室的印表機一樣，以前預設好排程列印就只能乖乖排隊，現在只要按住切換鍵，就能臨時插單立刻印出，也能隨時把即時文件收進佇列。⟧新增的 `alt+m` 快捷鍵，能依據你在 `/config` 裡設定的訊息排隊模式（Queued Messages）反向發送。在 macOS 上若將 Option 鍵設為 Alt，對應的按鍵組合是 `Option+m`。如果你平時處於排隊模式（Queue），按下這組快捷鍵就會立刻送出眼前這則訊息。反過來說，若平時處於即時發送模式（Send Immediately），這組按鍵則會幫你把訊息存進排程佇列。
body.en: When typing a message and preparing to send it, finding that the current mode opposes what you need previously required a tedious trip through the settings menu. ⟦Think of using an office printer: where a scheduled print preset once forced you to wait in line, holding a toggle key now lets you jump ahead for an immediate print or route an urgent document into the queue at any time.⟧ The new `alt+m` shortcut inverts sending behavior based on the Queued Messages mode configured in `/config`. On macOS, if the Option key is mapped to Alt, the corresponding combination is `Option+m`. If you are normally in Queue mode, pressing this shortcut sends the current message immediately. Conversely, if you are normally in Send Immediately mode, this key combination saves your message into the scheduled queue.

items.original: Added the `alt+m` shortcut (`Option+m` on macOS when Option is set to act as Alt) to send a message using the opposite of your `Queued Messages` setting in `/config`, so you can send right away while in `Queue` mode, or queue a message while in `Send Immediately` mode.

title.zh-TW: 外掛驗證規則對齊執行環境，行號與格式錯誤一目了然
title.en: Plugin validation rules align with runtime, making line numbers and format errors clear

body.zh-TW: 開發外掛時最怕驗證工具回報合格，實際載入執行時卻因為隱蔽問題而無法啟動。⟦拿稿件去印刷廠打樣，以前簡易校對常誤判合格格式、又漏看致命排版問題，現在校對標準完全對齊正式印刷機台，哪個檔案第幾行出錯都會清楚標出。⟧驗證指令 `agy plugin validate` 現在改用與執行環境完全相同的規則來檢查外掛。過去簡化的檢查會誤擋未填 `name` 欄位的合格清單，卻又漏掉阻礙外掛載入的真正問題。現在檢查工具會精確標示每個錯誤與警告所在的檔案與行號，且同時接受外掛目錄或個別 `plugin.json` 檔案。工具還會提示 `plugin.json` 的常見錯誤，像是未知欄位與猜測建議、無效名稱，或組件誤置於 `.antigravity-plugin/` 而非根目錄。另外可搭配 `--strict` 讓警告一律算失敗，或使用 `--json` 在自動化建置中輸出報告。
body.en: When developing plugins, nothing is worse than a validation tool reporting success only for hidden problems to block execution at runtime. ⟦A draft sent to a print shop for proofing once suffered from simplified checks that misjudged valid formats while missing fatal layout flaws, but proofs now align entirely with production presses to clearly mark which file and line contain errors.⟧ The validation command `agy plugin validate` now checks plugins using the exact same rules as the runtime environment. In the past, simplified checks falsely blocked valid manifests missing a `name` field while overlooking real issues that prevented plugins from loading. The validation tool now pinpoints the exact file and line number for every error and warning, accepting either plugin directories or individual `plugin.json` files. It also flags common `plugin.json` mistakes, such as unknown fields with suggested fixes, invalid names, or components mistakenly placed in `.antigravity-plugin/` instead of the root directory. Additionally, you can pair it with `--strict` to treat warnings as failures, or use `--json` to output reports in automated builds.

items.original: Improved `agy plugin validate` so it checks a plugin with the same rules the CLI uses to load it, instead of simplified checks that rejected valid plugins (such as a manifest without a `name`) and missed problems that kept a plugin from loading. It lists each error and warning with its file and line, accepts a plugin directory or its `plugin.json`, warns about common `plugin.json` mistakes such as unknown fields (with "did you mean" suggestions), invalid names, and components placed inside `.antigravity-plugin/` instead of the plugin root, and adds `--strict` to fail on warnings and `--json` for a machine-readable report in CI.

title.zh-TW: 啟動驗證暫時斷線會自動重試，不再鎖死工作階段
title.en: Startup eligibility checks retry on transient errors without locking the session

body.zh-TW: 在網路偶爾斷線或啟動時剛好撞上限流的時刻，終端機若突然整台卡住、拒收訊息，往往讓人不知所措。以前只要啟動時服務短暫連不上或達到速率限制，終端機就會持續跳出 `Eligibility check failed` 錯誤並拒絕每則訊息，非得重開程式不可。現在這項資格檢查遇到暫時性錯誤時會自動重試，不再鎖死整個工作階段，這個問題已經修好，連線恢復後就能直接繼續對話。
body.en: When the network drops intermittently or startup runs into rate limits, having the entire terminal freeze and reject input is disorienting. Previously, if the service became briefly unreachable or hit a rate limit at launch, the terminal repeatedly threw `Eligibility check failed` errors and rejected every message, leaving you no choice but to restart the application. This eligibility check now automatically retries on transient errors instead of locking up the entire session. This issue has been fixed, allowing you to resume your conversation as soon as connectivity recovers.

items.original: Fixed the CLI refusing every message with `Eligibility check failed` until you restarted it when the service was briefly unavailable or rate-limited at launch; the check now retries temporary errors and no longer locks the session.

title.zh-TW: 外掛 MCP 標頭支援變數替換，權杖驗證不再傳送字面占位符
title.en: Plugin MCP headers support variable substitution, preventing token authentication from sending literal placeholders

body.zh-TW: 替外掛串接需要身分驗證的自訂服務時，最怕設定好的金鑰變數沒有被正確代入。外掛中的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器如果在請求標頭使用了變數，例如 `"Authorization": "Bearer ${TOKEN}"`，以前會直接送出原始占位符而驗證失敗。現在標頭能像伺服器的指令、參數與環境變數一樣，正確代入你設定的數值，驗證失敗的問題已經修好。
body.en: When connecting a plugin to a custom service that requires authentication, nothing is worse than having configured secret variables fail to substitute properly. If an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server in a plugin used variables in request headers, such as `"Authorization": "Bearer ${TOKEN}"`, it previously sent the raw placeholder directly and failed authentication. Headers now properly substitute your configured values just like server commands, arguments, and environment variables, fixing the authentication failure.

items.original: Fixed plugin MCP servers that use a variable in a request header, such as `"Authorization": "Bearer ${TOKEN}"`, sending the literal placeholder and failing to authenticate; headers now get the value you configured, like the server's command, arguments, and environment already did.

title.zh-TW: 差異比較畫面填滿終端機，支援瀏覽百筆提交紀錄
title.en: Diff view fills terminal height and supports browsing up to a hundred commits

body.zh-TW: 想回顧專案最近的修改歷程時，在終端機裡瀏覽歷史版本往往受限於視野與操作順暢度。在 `/diff` 的提交樹（Commit Tree）檢視畫面中，以前頂端只會計算行數，而且最多只能看到最近 10 筆紀錄。現在整個畫面會自動填滿終端機高度，並支援捲動瀏覽最近 100 筆提交紀錄。頂端標題改為正確顯示提交筆數，游標也只會在提交列停留，只要按下 `Enter` 就能直接開啟該筆內容。
body.en: When reviewing recent project revisions, browsing commit history inside a terminal is often constrained by viewport limits and navigation friction. In the `/diff` commit tree view, the header previously only counted lines and capped visibility at the 10 most recent commits. The view now expands to fill the full terminal height and supports scrolling through the 100 most recent commits. The top header now correctly displays the commit count, the cursor only stops on commit rows, and pressing `Enter` directly opens the selected entry.

items.original: Fixed the `/diff` Commit Tree view: the header now counts commits instead of lines, the cursor stops only on commit rows and `Enter` opens that commit, the view fills the terminal height, and it shows the latest 100 commits (previously 10) with scrolling.

title.zh-TW: 背景指令狀態不再回溯，完整保留工作進度與日誌
title.en: Background command state no longer rolls back, keeping work progress and logs intact

body.zh-TW:
讓 AI 助理在背景執行耗時指令的同時，如果你繼續在前景修改程式碼，現在兩邊的進度都不會再莫名遺失。

以前只要背景指令執行完畢，若助理仍在持續工作，手邊剛修改的檔案、任務清單與工作階段花費就會全部遺失，甚至倒退回該指令剛啟動時的狀態。現在狀態回溯問題已經修好，背景任務結束時會妥善保留所有前景進度。

背景指令的任務日誌過去有時會漏掉最後幾行輸出。現在無論指令是正常完成還是中途被取消，最終輸出內容都會完整寫入日誌中。⟦如同把大批文件交給影印機後轉頭批閱公文，以前影印結束時，剛批好的文件會莫名倒退回未批狀態，現在影印和手邊進度都能各自完整保留。⟧
body.en:
When having the AI assistant run time-consuming commands in the background while you continue editing code in the foreground, progress on both sides is no longer mysteriously lost.

Previously, once a background command finished, if the assistant was still actively working, your recent file edits, task lists, and session spend were entirely lost, even rolling back to the state when that command first started. This state regression issue is now fixed, cleanly preserving all foreground progress when background tasks complete.

Task logs for background commands also previously missed the last few lines of output at times. Whether a command finishes normally or is canceled midway through, the final output is now fully written into the log. ⟦Consider handing a large stack of documents to a copier while reviewing paperwork at your desk: previously, finishing the copy job mysteriously reverted freshly reviewed papers to an unreviewed state, but copying and foreground work are now preserved completely.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the agent losing track of its file changes, tasks, and session cost when a background command finished while the agent kept working; they no longer roll back to the point where that command started.
Fixed a background command's final output sometimes missing from its task log; the output is now always recorded when the command finishes or is canceled.

title.zh-TW: 回覆中的資料夾連結恢復顯示，不再留下一片空白
title.en: Folder links in responses reappear, leaving no blank gaps

body.zh-TW: 看著 AI 助理在回答中推薦某個專案目錄時，如果路徑文字整段消失，往往讓人摸不著頭緒。以前助理的回覆如果包含指向資料夾的連結，該連結文字有時會從畫面上消失，讓整段說明缺字斷句。現在這個問題已經修好，回答會正常顯示出資料夾名稱，例如 `pipelines/`，讓你一眼看清路徑位置。
body.en: When reading an AI assistant response that recommends a project directory, having the path text vanish entirely is confusing. Previously, if the assistant response contained a link pointing to a folder, the link text occasionally disappeared from the screen, leaving broken sentences with missing words. This issue is now fixed, and responses display folder names normally, such as `pipelines/`, allowing you to see path locations at a glance.

items.original: Fixed links to directories disappearing from agent responses; they now show the directory name, for example `pipelines/`.

entries: Added Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 for Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`) sign-in. Claude models now appear in `/model` only if your Google Cloud project can use them.

Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox: the review is faster and no longer times out without a decision, it allows the workspace's own format, lint, and fix commands instead of asking about them, and it blocks commands that would upload sensitive data.

Improved the `/diff` Commit Tree view with colors: commit hashes and change IDs are highlighted, descriptions are dimmed, the `Working Copy (Uncommitted Changes)` row stands out, and `@` is bold, so hashes, timestamps, and descriptions no longer run together.

Fixed the agent hanging indefinitely when the model connection stalled: if no data arrives for 5 minutes the request is now canceled and retried automatically, and a stalled request no longer leaves an empty response step behind.

Fixed questions asked by subagents and workflow agents being lost, which left the subagent waiting forever: the alert now reads `<agent> has a question` and shows it, and `Ctrl+K` or `a` in the subagent's view opens a question picker that sends your answer to that agent. Headless `-p` runs skip these questions so the subagent can continue.

Fixed agent shell commands hanging on an invisible editor when a version control command wants one, such as `git commit` without `-m` or `jj describe`: the CLI now sets `GIT_EDITOR`, `HGEDITOR`, and `JJ_EDITOR` to `false` for agent commands, so they fail right away instead.

Fixed skills, rules, workflows, and Markdown agents failing to load with `mapping values are not allowed in this context` when an unquoted `description:` contains a colon, such as `description: Runs checks: formatters and linters.`

Fixed Mermaid diagrams that start with YAML frontmatter, a `%%{init: ...}%%` directive, or `%%` comments, or that use Mermaid v11 syntax such as `id@{ shape: ..., label: ... }` nodes, showing as raw source instead of rendering in agent responses and the artifact viewer.
Fixed the `@` file-mention dropdown staying open after a newline in a multi-line prompt, where it took over `Up`/`Down` and made `Enter` pick a file instead of inserting the newline.

Fixed `/` search in the file and artifact viewer highlighting the wrong characters, or crashing, on lines with letters whose lowercase form has a different length such as `İ`; `n` and `N` now stop only on lines that show a highlight.
Fixed long lines and file paths containing CJK or other multi-byte text turning into `�` characters in `/codesearch` results; they are now cut cleanly with an ellipsis.
Fixed `agy plugin validate`, the summary `agy plugin install` prints, and marketplace previews in the `/plugin` Discover tab leaving out subagents a plugin declares in its root `agents.json`.

Fixed plugin names and manifests being case-sensitive where the agent was not: `/plugin` subcommands such as `/plugin List` now work in any case instead of failing with `Unknown subcommand`, and a manifest named `Plugin.json` is now found by `agy plugin install`, `agy plugin validate`, and enable and disable.

title.zh-TW: 支援雲端憑證登入 Claude 5.5，權限符合才列出模型
title.en: Support Cloud Credential Login for Claude 5.5 and List Models Only When Permissions Match

body.zh-TW: 如果你平時依賴 Google Cloud 的應用程式預設憑證登入工具，現在環境變數 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 已經正式支援 Claude Opus 5.5 與 Claude Sonnet 5.5 兩款模型。只要在終端機打 `/model` 切換模型，選單就不會再把所有選項一口氣倒給你，而是會先檢查你的 Google Cloud 專案權限。⟦跟持識別證走進大型研發園區一樣，以前不管個人資格有沒有開通，預約看板都會列出所有設備，等登記時才碰壁；現在看板會先核對專案清單，只有你真正能啟用的實驗室才會亮起。⟧當你正在處理需要高強度推理的系統架構，想切換到更合適的模型時，只要打 `/model`，就能直接確認目前專案是否獲准調用這兩款 Claude 5.5 模型。這避免了你選取模型後送出請求，才因為專案缺少權限而中途失敗。
body.en: If you rely on Google Cloud Application Default Credentials to sign in to the tool, the `AGY_ADC_AUTH` environment variable now officially supports Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5. Whenever you type `/model` in the terminal to switch models, the menu no longer dumps every option onto you at once, but first checks your Google Cloud project permissions. ⟦Think of walking into a large research campus with an access badge: previously, the booking board listed every facility regardless of whether your credentials had been granted, leaving you stuck at check-in; now, the board checks your project list first, lighting up only the labs you can actually activate.⟧ When you are working on a system architecture that requires intensive reasoning and want to switch to a more suitable model, typing `/model` lets you directly verify whether the current project is authorized to call these two Claude 5.5 models. This prevents you from selecting a model and sending a request, only to have it fail midway due to missing project permissions.

items.original: Added Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 for Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`) sign-in. Claude models now appear in `/model` only if your Google Cloud project can use them.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式審查提速，放行程式碼整理並攔截敏感資料
title.en: Accelerate Auto Mode Reviews to Allow Code Cleanup and Block Sensitive Data

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟自動模式讓工具自行修改專案時，只要指令需要跨出終端機沙盒（隔離執行指令的受保護環境），現在審查流程變得更快而且不再無故逾時。⟦就像貨運物流中心的智慧安檢線，以前每件包裹都要等主管蓋章甚至拖到下班逾期，現在例行整理作業直接放行，但只要測出夾帶未授權的危險物品就立刻攔截。⟧對於專案工作區自帶的程式碼格式化、檢查與自動修復指令，審查機制會直接判斷安全並放行，不會再三停下來跳出提示打擾你。相對地，要是指令試圖將專案裡的敏感資料上傳到外部，工具會第一時間阻擋該動作，保護你的隱私與憑證安全。
body.en: When you enable auto mode to let the tool modify your project, any command that needs to step outside the terminal sandbox (a protected environment for isolated command execution) now undergoes a faster review process that no longer times out for no reason. ⟦Picture a smart security checkpoint at a freight logistics center: previously, every package had to wait for a supervisor's stamp or even timed out past closing; now, routine sorting operations pass straight through, while unauthorized hazardous goods are immediately intercepted upon detection.⟧ For built-in code formatting, linting, and autofix commands in your project workspace, the review mechanism directly determines they are safe and allows them through without repeatedly pausing to prompt you. Conversely, if a command attempts to upload sensitive project data externally, the tool immediately blocks the action to protect your privacy and credentials.

items.original: Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox: the review is faster and no longer times out without a decision, it allows the workspace's own format, lint, and fix commands instead of asking about them, and it blocks commands that would upload sensitive data.

title.zh-TW: 提交樹視覺配色翻新，版本雜湊與修改說明層次分明
title.en: Refresh Visual Color Scheme for Commit Tree with Clear Hierarchy for Hashes and Descriptions

body.zh-TW: 每次打 `/diff` 檢視版本提交樹時，你不再需要在一片灰白的純文字裡吃力尋找剛改動的內容。⟦好比查對加註色彩的財務對帳單，以前所有數字與明細全擠成一團難以分辨，現在交易編號清晰標亮、說明備註淡化處理，尚未結清的最新項目也格外醒目。⟧畫面上提交紀錄的雜湊值（commit hash，Git 用來標記特定版本的一串代碼）與變更識別碼現在都有高亮色彩，讓每個版本節點一目了然。相對地，次要的提交說明文字則調暗顯示，代表當前位置的 `@` 符號加粗呈現，未提交的工作複本（Working Copy）一整列更是清晰凸顯，讓版本代碼、時間戳記與說明文字徹底分開，不再黏成難以閱讀的文字區塊。
body.en: Whenever you type `/diff` to inspect the commit tree, you no longer need to struggle through monochrome plain text to locate your recent changes. ⟦A color-coded financial statement illustrates the change: previously, every figure and line item blurred together in an indistinguishable block; now, transaction numbers are brightly highlighted, descriptive notes are dimmed, and unsettled recent entries stand out prominently.⟧ Commit hashes and change identifiers across the display now feature highlighted colors, making each revision node immediately clear at a glance. In contrast, secondary commit descriptions are dimmed, the `@` symbol representing your current position is bolded, and the entire row for an uncommitted working copy is sharply accented, cleanly separating revision codes, timestamps, and descriptive text so they no longer blur into an illegible block of text.

items.original: Improved the `/diff` Commit Tree view with colors: commit hashes and change IDs are highlighted, descriptions are dimmed, the `Working Copy (Uncommitted Changes)` row stands out, and `@` is bold, so hashes, timestamps, and descriptions no longer run together.

title.zh-TW: 修復代理人無故卡死，連線重試、提問互動與指令防呆到位
title.en: Fix Agent Stalls with Connection Retries, Question Interactions, and Command Safeguards

body.zh-TW: 放手讓背景代理人執行繁重任務時，你最怕它無聲無息卡在半路、永遠等不到下一步。當模型連線停滯且超過 5 分鐘沒有傳回任何資料時，請求會自動取消並重新嘗試，中斷的請求也不會再於紀錄中留下一片空白的回覆步驟。子代理人與工作流程代理人主動發問時，提問不再悄悄遺失；介面現在會明確跳出提示顯示哪個代理人有問題，按快捷鍵 `Ctrl+K` 或 `a` 就能開啟選單作答。若是使用 `-p` 參數的無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機畫面的執行模式），則會自動略過這些提問以確保流程不中斷。遇到執行版本控制指令需要文字編輯器的情況（例如沒加 `-m` 的 `git commit` 或 `jj describe`），工具會直接將編輯器環境變數設為 `false`，讓指令當場報錯失敗，避免代理人卡在看不見的背景編輯器裡乾等。
body.en: When letting a background agent handle heavy tasks, the biggest worry is having it stall midway in silence, leaving you waiting indefinitely for the next step. If the model connection stalls and returns no data for more than 5 minutes, the request is automatically canceled and retried, and interrupted requests no longer leave a blank response step in the log. When subagents or workflow agents ask questions, their inquiries are no longer quietly lost. The interface now clearly displays a prompt indicating which agent has a question, and pressing the `Ctrl+K` or `a` shortcut opens a menu to answer. When running in headless mode with the `-p` flag (an execution mode without a terminal window), these questions are automatically skipped to ensure the workflow continues uninterrupted. When a version control command requires a text editor (such as `git commit` or `jj describe` without `-m`), the tool directly sets the editor environment variable to `false`. This fails the command immediately with an error, preventing the agent from idling in an invisible background editor.

items.original:
Fixed the agent hanging indefinitely when the model connection stalled: if no data arrives for 5 minutes the request is now canceled and retried automatically, and a stalled request no longer leaves an empty response step behind.
Fixed questions asked by subagents and workflow agents being lost, which left the subagent waiting forever: the alert now reads `<agent> has a question` and shows it, and `Ctrl+K` or `a` in the subagent's view opens a question picker that sends your answer to that agent. Headless `-p` runs skip these questions so the subagent can continue.
Fixed agent shell commands hanging on an invisible editor when a version control command wants one, such as `git commit` without `-m` or `jj describe`: the CLI now sets `GIT_EDITOR`, `HGEDITOR`, and `JJ_EDITOR` to `false` for agent commands, so they fail right away instead.

title.zh-TW: 擴充設定與外掛解析修復，冒號字串與指令大小寫皆能識別
title.en: Fix Extension Settings and Plugin Parsing to Recognize Colons in Strings and Command Casing

body.zh-TW: 在擴充自訂技能或管理外部外掛程式時，設定檔裡的微小語法差異不再導致載入失敗。為自訂技能、規則、工作流程或 Markdown 代理人編寫說明時，即使在 `description:` 後方未加引號的文字中包含冒號，也能順利解析，不再跳出格式錯誤訊息而中斷載入。外掛若在根目錄的 `agents.json` 宣告了子代理人，現在執行 `agy plugin validate` 驗證、`agy plugin install` 顯示安裝摘要，或在 `/plugin` 探索分頁瀏覽市集預覽時，都會如實列出，不再遭遺漏。外掛指令與資訊清單現在不再嚴格區分英文大小寫。打 `/plugin List` 等子指令不再因大寫報錯，資訊清單檔名若取為 `Plugin.json`，在安裝、驗證以及啟用或停用時也都能正確辨識。
body.en: When extending custom skills or managing external plugins, minor syntax differences in configuration files no longer cause load failures. When writing descriptions for custom skills, rules, workflows, or Markdown agents, unquoted text following `description:` parses smoothly even if it contains a colon, rather than throwing a formatting error that aborts loading. If a plugin declares subagents in its root `agents.json`, running `agy plugin validate` to verify, running `agy plugin install` to view the installation summary, or browsing the marketplace preview on the `/plugin` Discover tab will now faithfully list them without omissions. Plugin commands and manifests are also no longer strictly case-sensitive. Typing subcommands such as `/plugin List` no longer errors out due to uppercase letters, and a manifest file named `Plugin.json` is properly recognized during installation, validation, activation, and deactivation.

items.original:
Fixed skills, rules, workflows, and Markdown agents failing to load with `mapping values are not allowed in this context` when an unquoted `description:` contains a colon, such as `description: Runs checks: formatters and linters.`
Fixed `agy plugin validate`, the summary `agy plugin install` prints, and marketplace previews in the `/plugin` Discover tab leaving out subagents a plugin declares in its root `agents.json`.
Fixed plugin names and manifests being case-sensitive where the agent was not: `/plugin` subcommands such as `/plugin List` now work in any case instead of failing with `Unknown subcommand`, and a manifest named `Plugin.json` is now found by `agy plugin install`, `agy plugin validate`, and enable and disable.

title.zh-TW: Mermaid 圖表渲染修復，註解指令與新版語法正常繪製
title.en: Fix Mermaid Diagram Rendering to Properly Draw Directives, Comments, and New Syntax

body.zh-TW: 在檢視代理人回覆或產出物檢視器的圖表時，Mermaid 圖形現在都能正常渲染呈現。以前只要圖表開頭帶有 YAML 前置資料、`%%{init: ...}%%` 指令、`%%` 註解，或是使用 Mermaid v11 節點語法（例如 `id@{ shape: ..., label: ... }`），畫面就會直接印出一整段原始碼文字。現在這些語法都能正確繪製成視覺圖表。
body.en: When viewing diagrams in agent responses or the artifact viewer, Mermaid diagrams now render properly. Previously, whenever a diagram began with YAML frontmatter, a `%%{init: ...}%%` directive, `%%` comments, or used Mermaid v11 node syntax (such as `id@{ shape: ..., label: ... }`), the display would simply print out a raw block of source code. Now, all such syntax renders correctly into visual diagrams.

items.original: Fixed Mermaid diagrams that start with YAML frontmatter, a `%%{init: ...}%%` directive, or `%%` comments, or that use Mermaid v11 syntax such as `id@{ shape: ..., label: ... }` nodes, showing as raw source instead of rendering in agent responses and the artifact viewer.

title.zh-TW: 多行提示詞換行順暢，檔案提及選單不再干擾按鍵
title.en: Smooth Multiline Prompt Line Breaks Without File Mention Menu Interfering with Keystrokes

body.zh-TW: 當你在輸入框寫下較長的需求、按下換行準備分段時，最怕編輯節奏莫名被打亂。以前只要在輸入內容中打出 `@` 喚起檔案下拉選單，接著換行時選單仍然會持續卡在畫面上，強行攔截你的上下方向鍵，按下 Enter 鍵更會直接誤選檔案，而不是如期插入新的一行。這個選單殘留的問題已經修好，讓你換行編輯文字時不再被按鍵劫持。
body.en: When writing longer requirements in the input box and pressing Enter to start a new paragraph, the last thing you want is having your editing rhythm disrupted. Previously, typing `@` in the input summoned the file dropdown menu, and pressing Enter to insert a line break left the menu stuck on screen. It forcibly intercepted your up and down arrow keys, and pressing Enter accidentally selected a file instead of inserting a newline as expected. This menu persistence issue has been fixed so that line-breaking and editing text are no longer hijacked by keystrokes.

items.original: Fixed the `@` file-mention dropdown staying open after a newline in a multi-line prompt, where it took over `Up`/`Down` and made `Enter` pick a file instead of inserting the newline.

title.zh-TW: 檢視器搜尋定位修復，特殊字母不再錯位或當機
title.en: Fix Viewer Search Positioning to Prevent Misalignment and Crashes on Special Characters

body.zh-TW: 在檔案與產出物檢視器中按 `/` 搜尋內文時，遇到特殊字母現在能精確標亮目標。以前若行內包含轉成小寫後字元長度會改變的字母（例如土耳其語的大寫「İ」），搜尋時高亮標記會對錯字元甚至引發當機，使用 `n` 與 `N` 跳轉時也常常停在根本沒有亮起的行。現在字元對應錯誤已修好，按 `n` 與 `N` 切換時也只會停在真正帶有高亮的行上。
body.en: When pressing `/` to search file contents in the file and artifact viewers, the target is now accurately highlighted even when encountering special characters. Previously, if a line contained characters whose length changed upon lowercasing (such as the Turkish capital "İ"), search highlighting would misalign with characters or even trigger a crash. Navigating with `n` and `N` often stopped on lines that were not highlighted at all. Character mapping errors are now resolved, and cycling with `n` and `N` lands only on lines that actually contain highlights.

items.original: Fixed `/` search in the file and artifact viewer highlighting the wrong characters, or crashing, on lines with letters whose lowercase form has a different length such as `İ`; `n` and `N` now stop only on lines that show a highlight.

title.zh-TW: 程式碼搜尋支援中文長路徑，斷行不再切碎字元變亂碼
title.en: Support Long Chinese Paths in Code Search to Prevent Truncating Multibyte Characters into Mojibake

body.zh-TW: 在專案中執行 `/codesearch` 查找程式碼時，搜尋結果包含多位元組文字現在排版更為俐落。以前只要程式碼長行或檔案路徑含有 CJK（中日韓統一表意文字）等字元，在終端機寬度限制下截斷時，字元位元組常會被切碎，導致結尾顯示出亂碼符號「」。現在遇到長行與路徑都會在安全邊界乾淨加上省略號，不再產生亂碼。
body.en: When running `/codesearch` to look up code across a project, search results containing multibyte text are now laid out much more cleanly. Previously, whenever long lines of code or file paths contained characters like CJK (Chinese, Japanese, and Korean unified ideographs), truncating them at the terminal width boundary frequently shredded character bytes and produced the replacement symbol "" at the end. Now, long lines and paths are cleanly truncated with ellipses at safe boundaries, preventing mojibake.

items.original: Fixed long lines and file paths containing CJK or other multi-byte text turning into `�` characters in `/codesearch` results; they are now cut cleanly with an ellipsis.

entries: Added Auto mode, which approves file edits and safe commands without asking and still prompts before irreversible actions; commands that would leave the terminal sandbox are first reviewed by a separate agent. Choose it with `--mode auto`, from `Agent Mode` in `/config`, or by pressing `Shift+Tab` to cycle modes. Auto mode is available on Linux and macOS, with Windows support coming later.

Added the `/compact` command to compact the conversation on demand and free up the context window: `/compact` on its own summarizes the conversation and ends the turn, and `/compact <message>` summarizes it and then answers your message. While it runs the CLI shows a `Compacting conversation...` progress label that you can cancel with `Esc`, and when it finishes it shows how many steps were summarized and how much smaller the context became.

Added syntax highlighting to the `/diff` file view, with token colors for each color scheme and a background tint on added and removed lines. With the `Terminal` color scheme the CLI detects whether your terminal has a light or dark background and picks matching colors. The color scheme previews in `/config` and first-run setup now show a sample exactly as `/diff` draws it.

Added folding to the `/diff` file view: each hunk header now shows how many unchanged lines are hidden above it, `Ctrl+O` expands or collapses the fold nearest the cursor, and `f` switches between showing only the changes and the whole file. Both keys work on uncommitted changes when the file on disk still matches the diff, and the footer explains when they can't be used.

Improved `/diff` performance on very large files by rendering only the rows on screen, so scrolling, expanding folds, and opening the whole file no longer freeze the CLI. Expanding folds and showing the whole file are turned off for files over 100,000 lines or 10 MB, and the footer says why.

Fixed colors being reduced to 256 colors in iTerm2 over SSH, where `COLORTERM` is not forwarded; the CLI now uses full 24-bit color when `LC_TERMINAL=iTerm2` is set, unless `COLORTERM` or `NO_COLOR` says otherwise.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式登場，常規修改直接放行免反覆確認
title.en: Auto Mode Arrives, Allowing Routine Changes Directly Without Repeated Confirmations

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡請 AI 幫忙寫程式或改檔案時，每動一行代碼都要停下來等你按 Enter 同意，流程往往被打得支離破碎。⟦宛如聘請具備授權的專業秘書，平時修改筆記或整理歸檔會直接代勞，只有遇到銷毀重要資料或簽署大筆合約時才會敲門請示。⟧新加入的自動模式（auto mode，自動核准安全操作的執行模式）會自動放行檔案編輯與安全指令，但在執行不可逆操作前依然會主動提示。要是指令可能脫離終端機沙盒（限制程式執行範圍的隔離環境），還會先交由另一個獨立代理人審查。你可以輸入 `--mode auto`、在 `/config` 裡選擇 `Agent Mode`，或是按 `Shift+Tab` 鍵循環切換模式。這項功能目前已支援 Linux 與 macOS，Windows 支援則會在後續版本推出。
body.en: When asking AI to write code or edit files in the terminal, having to pause and press Enter for every single line often shatters your workflow. ⟦Picture hiring an empowered executive assistant who handles editing notes or archiving files directly, knocking on your door only to shred critical records or sign major contracts.⟧ The newly added auto mode (an execution mode that automatically approves safe operations) automatically allows file edits and safe commands, yet it still prompts before executing irreversible actions. If a command might escape the terminal sandbox (an isolated environment restricting program execution scope), an independent agent reviews it first. You can enter `--mode auto`, select `Agent Mode` in `/config`, or press `Shift+Tab` to cycle through modes. This feature is currently supported on Linux and macOS, with Windows support arriving in a future release.

items.original: Added Auto mode, which approves file edits and safe commands without asking and still prompts before irreversible actions; commands that would leave the terminal sandbox are first reviewed by a separate agent. Choose it with `--mode auto`, from `Agent Mode` in `/config`, or by pressing `Shift+Tab` to cycle modes. Auto mode is available on Linux and macOS, with Windows support coming later.

title.zh-TW: 新增 /compact 指令，隨時壓縮對話釋放記憶空間
title.en: New /compact Command Compresses Conversations Anytime to Free Up Memory

body.zh-TW: 和 AI 討論專案來回好幾輪之後，對話紀錄越積越長，往往會把模型一次能閱讀的長度塞得滿滿當當。⟦跟整理厚重的會議紀錄本一樣，以前寫到頁尾只能整本封存換新冊子，現在助理會當場把前面發言濃縮成精華摘要，空出乾淨版面讓你接著寫。⟧現在你可以隨時輸入 `/compact` 來壓縮對話並釋出脈絡視窗（context window，AI 一次能讀取與記住的最大文字範圍）。單獨執行 `/compact` 會總結目前的對話並結束這個回合。若是輸入 `/compact <message>`，它則會在完成總結後接著回答你的新問題。壓縮執行期間終端機會顯示 `Compacting conversation...` 進度標籤，按 `Esc` 鍵就能隨時取消。處理完成後還會清楚列出總共整理了多少步對話，以及脈絡縮小了多少。
body.en: After multiple rounds of project discussions with AI, accumulating conversation logs often crowd the model's reading limit to capacity. ⟦Think of organizing a bulky meeting notebook where reaching the bottom of a page once required archiving the entire binder for a fresh one, but now an assistant condenses prior discussions into a concise summary on the spot, freeing up clean pages for you to keep writing.⟧ You can now enter `/compact` at any time to compress conversations and free up the context window (the maximum range of text an AI can read and retain at once). Running `/compact` by itself summarizes the current conversation and ends the turn. If you enter `/compact <message>`, it answers your new question right after finishing the summary. During compression, the terminal displays a `Compacting conversation...` progress indicator, and pressing `Esc` cancels at any time. Once finished, it clearly lists the total number of dialogue steps organized and how much context was reduced.

items.original: Added the `/compact` command to compact the conversation on demand and free up the context window: `/compact` on its own summarizes the conversation and ends the turn, and `/compact <message>` summarizes it and then answers your message. While it runs the CLI shows a `Compacting conversation...` progress label that you can cancel with `Esc`, and when it finishes it shows how many steps were summarized and how much smaller the context became.

title.zh-TW: /diff 支援語法上色與折疊，大檔捲動不再凍結
title.en: /diff Adds Syntax Highlighting and Folding, Ending Scrolling Freezes on Large Files

body.zh-TW: 在終端機核對程式碼變更時，面對落落長的未改動文字往往難以閱讀，遇到超大檔案甚至還會凍結畫面。⟦好比查閱附有彩色便箋的折疊地圖，以前整張大圖攤開難以翻動，現在關鍵標記帶有醒目底色，重複路段也能隨手收折。⟧`/diff` 現在加入語法上色，新增與刪除行帶有底色，各色彩配置也依 token（程式碼語法標記記號）顯示專屬顏色。選用 `Terminal` 配色能自動偵測終端機深淺底色配對顏色，`/config` 與初次安裝也能直接預覽 `/diff` 樣貌。區塊標頭現在會標示上方隱藏的未改動行數，按 `Ctrl+O` 可展開或收合游標處折疊，按 `f` 則切換僅變更或全文；未提交檔案與 diff 一致即可操作，無法使用時頁尾會說明。目前畫面只渲染螢幕可見行，捲動、展開或開啟全文不再凍結；超過 100,000 行或 10 MB 的檔案則停用展開與全文並於頁尾提示。
body.en: When reviewing code changes in the terminal, long stretches of unchanged text are often tedious to read, and unusually large files can even freeze the display. ⟦Like reading a folded map with color-coded sticky notes, unfolding the entire sheet once made navigation cumbersome, but now key markers carry prominent background tints and repetitive routes fold away conveniently.⟧ The `/diff` command now adds syntax highlighting, with tinted backgrounds for added and deleted lines, and each color scheme displays dedicated colors based on tokens (syntax units in code). Selecting the `Terminal` theme automatically detects terminal background tones to match colors, and `/config` as well as initial installation offer direct previews of `/diff`. Block headers now indicate the number of hidden unchanged lines above them. Pressing `Ctrl+O` expands or collapses the fold at the cursor, while pressing `f` toggles between changes-only and full text. These operations work as long as uncommitted files match the diff, and the footer explains when they are unavailable. Currently, only lines visible on screen are rendered, so scrolling, expanding, or opening full text no longer freezes. Files exceeding 100,000 lines or 10 MB disable expansion and full text while showing a footer notice.

items.original:
Added syntax highlighting to the `/diff` file view, with token colors for each color scheme and a background tint on added and removed lines. With the `Terminal` color scheme the CLI detects whether your terminal has a light or dark background and picks matching colors. The color scheme previews in `/config` and first-run setup now show a sample exactly as `/diff` draws it.
Added folding to the `/diff` file view: each hunk header now shows how many unchanged lines are hidden above it, `Ctrl+O` expands or collapses the fold nearest the cursor, and `f` switches between showing only the changes and the whole file. Both keys work on uncommitted changes when the file on disk still matches the diff, and the footer explains when they can't be used.
Improved `/diff` performance on very large files by rendering only the rows on screen, so scrolling, expanding folds, and opening the whole file no longer freeze the CLI. Expanding folds and showing the whole file are turned off for files over 100,000 lines or 10 MB, and the footer says why.

title.zh-TW: 遠端 iTerm2 顏色降級已修復，SSH 連線可享完整色彩
title.en: Remote iTerm2 Color Degradation Fixed, Restoring Full Color Over SSH

body.zh-TW: 透過 SSH 連線使用 iTerm2 時，以前若遇到未轉發 `COLORTERM` 的情況，終端機顯示會被降級成 256 色。現在只要設定了 `LC_TERMINAL=iTerm2`，除非 `COLORTERM` 或 `NO_COLOR` 另有指定，否則會直接啟用完整的 24 位元色彩；這項色彩降級問題已經修好，遠端登入時也能正常顯示鮮明配色。
body.en: When using iTerm2 over an SSH connection, terminal display previously degraded to 256 colors if `COLORTERM` was not forwarded. Setting `LC_TERMINAL=iTerm2` now directly enables full 24-bit color unless `COLORTERM` or `NO_COLOR` specifies otherwise. This color degradation issue has been resolved, allowing vivid color schemes to display normally during remote logins.

items.original: Fixed colors being reduced to 256 colors in iTerm2 over SSH, where `COLORTERM` is not forwarded; the CLI now uses full 24-bit color when `LC_TERMINAL=iTerm2` is set, unless `COLORTERM` or `NO_COLOR` says otherwise.

entries: Added a `--json` flag to `agy plugin list` for machine-readable output, and fixed the command showing only imported plugins: it now lists every installed plugin, including ones installed from a marketplace, with its version and whether it is enabled.

Changed `--model` and `/model` to accept a base model name without `--effort`: instead of failing with an error asking for `--effort`, the CLI now picks the model's default thinking level (the server's default for that model, otherwise medium, otherwise the lowest available).

Improved Remote Control so the browser's Settings modal opens for CLI sessions and shows the settings the CLI actually uses (project and global permissions, queued messages, AI credits, telemetry, and artifact review) instead of a notice that settings can't be changed in the browser, and `agy remote-control serve` sessions now use your saved `settings.json` and save changes made in the browser back to it.
Improved the `/model` picker for Business sign-in with a Google Cloud project on pay-as-you-go: third-party models your project can't access are now hidden instead of failing when you send a message.
Fixed long stalls when model requests fail repeatedly: the agent now waits at most 30 seconds between automatic retries instead of up to 4 minutes.

Fixed remote MCP servers that use OAuth signing you out after a temporary network failure, timeout, or server error; saved sign-ins are now cleared only when the server or its authorization server actually rejects them.

Fixed `--agent` silently running the default agent when the name matches no agent: headless `-p` runs now exit with code 1 and list the available agents, and interactive sessions show an `Agent Not Found` warning before falling back to the default agent.
Fixed combining `--print` with `--prompt-interactive` exiting with status 0 after reporting the conflict; it now exits with status 2 like other print-mode usage errors.
Fixed `/diff` showing `No uncommitted changes` in Git, Mercurial, and Jujutsu repositories configured to always color output, for example with `color.ui = always`.
Fixed `@conversation:` suggestions getting stuck on `Fetching matches for ...` when conversation search is slow; after 2 seconds the list now falls back to your local conversations.
Fixed the `Agents:` row in `/plugin` plugin details leaving out subagents a plugin declares in its root `agents.json`; it now lists every loaded agent by name instead of by its `agents/` folder name.

Fixed "Always allow" rules approved from a Remote Control browser session still applying after you removed them in the browser's rules editor or the shared tab of `/permissions`; these rules are now saved only to the shared `config.json`.
Fixed requests failing with `thinking_budget and thinking_level are not supported together` when signed in with Application Default Credentials and using a model that has a thinking level.
Fixed a conversation failing on every later request after the agent read a truncated or header-only WebM file; such files are now rejected when read instead of being attached.

title.zh-TW: 外掛與代理人清單完整列出，支援結構化輸出
title.en: Complete Plugin and Agent Listings with Structured Output Support

body.zh-TW: 當你安裝了許多擴充套件，想一次盤點目前啟用了哪些工具與專屬助理時，資訊常會顯示不全。⟦跟檢視樂團編制表一樣，以前只列出編制內樂手還漏寫客席聲部，現在連外聘演奏家與個別聲部名單都按正式姓名全數登載。⟧現在執行 `agy plugin list` 時新增了 `--json` 參數，能輸出方便程式解析的結構化資料。該指令不再只顯示手動匯入的套件，而是將從市集安裝的所有外掛、版本編號以及啟用狀態完整列出。在對話中輸入 `/plugin` 查看外掛詳情時，底下的代理人清單過去會漏掉在 `agents.json` 根目錄宣告的子代理人。這個問題已經修好，現在會依名稱完整顯示所有載入的代理人，不再只抓取資料夾名稱。
body.en: When you have installed many extensions and want to inventory which tools and dedicated assistants are currently active all at once, the information is often incomplete. ⟦Like checking an orchestra roster that previously listed only permanent musicians and missed guest sections, the roster now records every visiting performer and individual section member under their official name.⟧ Running `agy plugin list` now adds a `--json` flag to output structured data for easy programmatic parsing. The command no longer displays only manually imported packages, but completely lists all plugins installed from the marketplace along with their version numbers and enabled status. When typing `/plugin` in a chat to view plugin details, the agent list below previously omitted subagents declared at the root of `agents.json`. This issue is now fixed, and all loaded agents are fully displayed by name instead of only grabbing directory names.

items.original:
Added a `--json` flag to `agy plugin list` for machine-readable output, and fixed the command showing only imported plugins: it now lists every installed plugin, including ones installed from a marketplace, with its version and whether it is enabled.
Fixed the `Agents:` row in `/plugin` plugin details leaving out subagents a plugin declares in its root `agents.json`; it now lists every loaded agent by name instead of by its `agents/` folder name.

title.zh-TW: 模型切換省去思考參數，自動過濾無權限選項
title.en: Model Switching Omits Thinking Parameters and Automatically Filters Unauthorized Options

body.zh-TW: 想切換對話模型或調整推理解題深度時，以前常因為少打參數或選錯項目而卡住。⟦好比到餐廳點牛排，以前少交代熟度就無法送單，現在廚師會主動端出推薦熟度，點餐看板上也預先撤下沒供應的部位。⟧現在使用 `--model` 或 `/model` 指定模型時，可以直接填寫模型基礎名稱，不必強制加上 `--effort` 參數。系統會自動套用預設的思考層級（伺服器預設值，否則依序採用中等或最低層級），不再報錯中斷。若透過 Google Cloud 按量計費的商業帳號登入，選單會主動隱藏專案無權存取的第三方模型。另外使用應用程式預設憑證（ADC，讓本機直接取得雲端授權的機制）時，思考預算與思考層級衝突的報錯也已修復。
body.en: When switching chat models or tuning reasoning depth, users often got stuck due to missing parameters or selecting invalid options. ⟦Think of ordering steak at a restaurant: previously, leaving out the doneness level prevented placing an order, but now the chef serves a recommended doneness automatically, and unavailable cuts are removed from the menu board in advance.⟧ When specifying a model with `--model` or `/model`, you can now enter just the base model name without being required to add the `--effort` flag. The system automatically applies a default thinking effort (the server default, or otherwise medium or lowest in order) without throwing an error and halting. If logged in through a Google Cloud pay-as-you-go commercial account, the menu proactively hides third-party models that the project has no permission to access. In addition, an error where thinking budgets conflicted with thinking effort when using Application Default Credentials (ADC, a mechanism allowing local environments to directly obtain cloud authorization) has also been fixed.

items.original:
Changed `--model` and `/model` to accept a base model name without `--effort`: instead of failing with an error asking for `--effort`, the CLI now picks the model's default thinking level (the server's default for that model, otherwise medium, otherwise the lowest available).
Improved the `/model` picker for Business sign-in with a Google Cloud project on pay-as-you-go: third-party models your project can't access are now hidden instead of failing when you send a message.
Fixed requests failing with `thinking_budget and thinking_level are not supported together` when signed in with Application Default Credentials and using a model that has a thinking level.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制設定面板開放調整，權限刪除即時同步
title.en: Remote Control Settings Panel Opened for Adjustments with Instant Permission Deletion Sync

body.zh-TW: 出門在外用手機網頁查看終端機進度時，常常碰上偏好選項改不了、或是撤銷規則卻依然生效的窘境。⟦就像拿著平板遙控中央機房，以前面板只顯示無法修改，現在順手調整溫控或撤銷訪客門禁，實體主機的設定檔立刻同步更新。⟧瀏覽器遠端控制（Remote Control，讓使用者透過網頁介面操作終端機工作階段的功能）的設定面板現在已正式開放。視窗中會直接列出專案與全域權限、排隊訊息、AI 額度、遙測數據與工件審查等實際運作項目。透過 `agy remote-control serve` 啟動時會載入 `settings.json`，在網頁上的修改也會即時寫回本機。而在瀏覽器中核准的「永遠允許」規則，過去在規則編輯器或 `/permissions` 分頁移除後依然會繼續生效；現在規則只會存入共用的 `config.json`，移除後便立即失效。
body.en: When checking terminal progress via a mobile browser while away, users often ran into dilemmas where preference options could not be changed or revoked rules remained in effect. ⟦Picture managing a central server room from a tablet: previously the panel only displayed settings without allowing modifications, but now adjusting climate control or revoking visitor access immediately syncs the configuration files on the physical host.⟧ The settings panel for browser Remote Control (a feature allowing users to operate terminal sessions through a web interface) is now officially open. The window directly lists active items such as project and global permissions, queued messages, AI quotas, telemetry data, and artifact reviews. Starting via `agy remote-control serve` loads `settings.json`, and changes made on the web page are immediately written back to the local machine. Previously, "Always allow" rules approved in the browser remained in effect even after being removed in the rule editor or on the `/permissions` tab. Rules are now stored exclusively in the shared `config.json`, becoming invalid immediately upon removal.

items.original:
Improved Remote Control so the browser's Settings modal opens for CLI sessions and shows the settings the CLI actually uses (project and global permissions, queued messages, AI credits, telemetry, and artifact review) instead of a notice that settings can't be changed in the browser, and `agy remote-control serve` sessions now use your saved `settings.json` and save changes made in the browser back to it.
Fixed "Always allow" rules approved from a Remote Control browser session still applying after you removed them in the browser's rules editor or the shared tab of `/permissions`; these rules are now saved only to the shared `config.json`.

title.zh-TW: 指令參數錯誤不再靜默執行，明確回傳警告與狀態碼
title.en: Command Flag Errors No Longer Run Silently, Returning Explicit Warnings and Exit Codes

body.zh-TW: 在指令列啟動工具時，如果不小心打錯代理人名稱或組合了互相矛盾的參數，很容易因系統沒有明確阻止而產生誤解。⟦猶如車站剪票閘門，以前乘客拿錯票卡還會悄悄放行，現在若是無人自動驗票就立即亮紅燈攔截並列出可用票種，人工窗口也會先響起警告才做後續處置。⟧當使用 `--agent` 指定代理人卻拼錯名稱時，過去系統會默默改用預設代理人執行。現在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺畫面的執行模式）若搭配 `-p` 遇到名稱不符，會直接以狀態碼 1 結束並列出所有可用代理人。若在一般互動視窗遇到相同狀況，系統則會先顯示 `Agent Not Found` 警告才退回預設代理人。若將 `--print` 與 `--prompt-interactive` 混用，回報衝突後的退出狀態碼也已從原本代表成功的 0 改為狀態碼 2。
body.en: When launching tools from the command line, accidentally mistyping an agent name or combining contradictory flags could easily cause confusion because the system did not clearly intervene. ⟦A station ticket turnstile illustrates this shift: where passenger cards with errors were once quietly let through, automated gates now instantly flash red, intercept entry, and list valid ticket types, while staffed booths sound a warning before taking further action.⟧ When specifying an agent using `--agent` with a misspelled name, the system previously fell back silently to the default agent. In headless mode (an execution mode without a visual terminal interface) combined with `-p`, encountering an unmatched name now exits directly with status code 1 and lists all available agents. Under the same condition in a standard interactive window, the system now displays an `Agent Not Found` warning before falling back to the default agent. When mixing `--print` with `--prompt-interactive`, the exit code after reporting the conflict has also been changed from 0 (which originally indicated success) to exit code 2.

items.original:
Fixed `--agent` silently running the default agent when the name matches no agent: headless `-p` runs now exit with code 1 and list the available agents, and interactive sessions show an `Agent Not Found` warning before falling back to the default agent.
Fixed combining `--print` with `--prompt-interactive` exiting with status 0 after reporting the conflict; it now exits with status 2 like other print-mode usage errors.

title.zh-TW: 模型請求失敗重試間隔縮短，連線不順不再乾等
title.en: Model Request Failure Retry Intervals Shortened to Eliminate Idling During Unstable Connections

body.zh-TW: 當 AI 伺服器連線不穩或請求連續失敗時，以前終端機常常毫無反應。在模型請求遭遇連續失敗時，系統在自動重試之間的等待時間過去最長可達 4 分鐘，導致整個工作階段長時間停滯。這個問題現在已經修好，自動重試之間的等待間隔上限已縮短為最多 30 秒，減少連線異常時的乾等時間。
body.en: When connections to AI servers are unstable or requests fail repeatedly, the terminal previously often became unresponsive. During consecutive model request failures, the system previously waited up to 4 minutes between automatic retries, leaving the entire session stalled for extended periods. This issue has now been resolved, and the upper limit for wait intervals between automatic retries has been shortened to at most 30 seconds, reducing idle waiting time during connection abnormalities.

items.original: Fixed long stalls when model requests fail repeatedly: the agent now waits at most 30 seconds between automatic retries instead of up to 4 minutes.

title.zh-TW: 遠端 MCP 登入憑證更穩定，網路暫時中斷不強制登出
title.en: Remote MCP Login Credentials Stabilized to Prevent Forced Logout on Transient Network Drops

body.zh-TW: 使用需要網頁授權的遠端外掛時，最怕網路稍有波動就被強制登出。當連線至使用 OAuth 驗證的遠端 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，過去只要遭遇短暫網路中斷、逾時或伺服器錯誤，系統就會清除登入資訊。現在只有在授權伺服器確實拒絕驗證時才會清除紀錄，短暫斷線不再需要重新登入。
body.en: When using remote plugins that require web authorization, the biggest frustration was being forcibly logged out over minor network fluctuations. When connecting to a remote MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol allowing AI to connect to external tools) server that uses OAuth authentication, the system previously cleared login credentials whenever it encountered brief network interruptions, timeouts, or server errors. Now credentials are cleared only when the authorization server definitively rejects authentication, so brief disconnections no longer require logging in again.

items.original: Fixed remote MCP servers that use OAuth signing you out after a temporary network failure, timeout, or server error; saved sign-ins are now cleared only when the server or its authorization server actually rejects them.

title.zh-TW: 版本庫開啟彩色輸出時，比對指令不再誤報無變更
title.en: Diff Command No Longer Falsely Reports No Changes When Repositories Enable Color Output

body.zh-TW: 在對話中想查看程式碼修改進度時，終端機有時會明明有改動卻顯示一片空白。在 Git、Mercurial 或 Jujutsu 版本庫中輸入 `/diff` 查看變更時，若版本控制設定了強制彩色輸出（例如 `color.ui = always`），過去系統會誤判並顯示 `No uncommitted changes`。這個問題現在已經修好，即使環境開啟了色彩標記，指令也能正確讀取並顯示所有尚未提交的檔案修改。
body.en: When attempting to review code modification progress during a conversation, the terminal sometimes displayed blank output even when modifications were present. When entering `/diff` to inspect changes in a Git, Mercurial, or Jujutsu repository, if version control was configured to force color output (such as `color.ui = always`), the system previously misinterpreted the output and displayed `No uncommitted changes`. This issue has now been resolved, so the command properly reads and displays all uncommitted file modifications even when color formatting is enabled in the environment.

items.original: Fixed `/diff` showing `No uncommitted changes` in Git, Mercurial, and Jujutsu repositories configured to always color output, for example with `color.ui = always`.

title.zh-TW: 歷史對話搜尋逾時自動降級，清單不再卡住等待
title.en: Conversation History Search Automatically Fallbacks on Timeout Without Freezing the List

body.zh-TW: 在輸入框打字引入舊對話時，如果搜尋速度變慢，游標常常會被卡在原地無法挑選。在終端機輸入 `@conversation:` 尋找過往對話時，若對話搜尋速度較慢，選單過去會一直卡在 `Fetching matches for ...` 的讀取畫面。這個問題現在已經修好，只要等候超過 2 秒，選單就會自動退回顯示本機儲存的歷史對話，不必再漫長乾等。
body.en: When typing in the input box to reference an earlier conversation, slow searches often froze the cursor in place and prevented selection. When entering `@conversation:` in the terminal to search for past conversations, if the conversation lookup was slow, the menu previously stayed stuck on the `Fetching matches for ...` loading screen. This issue has now been resolved: after waiting more than 2 seconds, the menu automatically falls back to showing locally stored conversation history, eliminating the need to wait indefinitely.

items.original: Fixed `@conversation:` suggestions getting stuck on `Fetching matches for ...` when conversation search is slow; after 2 seconds the list now falls back to your local conversations.

title.zh-TW: 讀取殘缺影音檔直接拒絕，避免後續對話連鎖崩潰
title.en: Incomplete Media Files Rejected Directly to Prevent Cascading Conversation Failures

body.zh-TW: 讓代理人分析專案資料夾裡的媒體檔案時，若檔案未下載完整，可能導致後續整段交談全部報銷。當代理人讀取到內容不完整或只有標頭資訊的 WebM 影音檔案時，過去會將該檔案附加至工作階段中，導致後續的每一次對話請求全部發生錯誤。這個問題現在已經修好，系統在讀取到此類殘缺檔案時會直接拒絕載入，不再將損壞的附件帶入對話，確保後續操作能正常進行。
body.en: When having an agent analyze media files in a project folder, an incompletely downloaded file could ruin the entire subsequent conversation. When an agent read a WebM media file that was incomplete or contained only header information, the system previously attached the file to the session, causing every subsequent conversation request to fail with an error. This issue has now been resolved: the system directly refuses to load such incomplete files and no longer brings corrupted attachments into the conversation, ensuring subsequent operations proceed normally.

items.original: Fixed a conversation failing on every later request after the agent read a truncated or header-only WebM file; such files are now rejected when read instead of being attached.

entries: Added a pinned prompt header in no flickering mode while you scroll back through a long conversation: the prompt that produced the response you're reading stays at the top of the transcript, and clicking it jumps back to that prompt.

Added support for MCP servers to mark a tool as always loaded by setting `_meta: {"antigravity/alwaysLoad": true}` on it in their `tools/list` response, so the agent gets that tool directly instead of discovering it on demand.
Added support for a root-level `agents.json` in plugins, so a plugin can declare its subagents the same way it declares skills and rules with `skills.json` and `rules.json`.

Changed the macOS terminal sandbox to block sandboxed commands from reading `~/Library/Application Support` by default, since desktop apps keep credentials and session tokens there; previously it was readable, and you can still allow it explicitly in your sandbox rules.

Improved error messages: a request that fails with an HTML error page, for example from a corporate proxy, now shows the page title instead of the raw HTML, other long non-JSON error bodies are cut off after 500 bytes, and reaching your individual quota is reported right away instead of being retried.

Improved search in the `/plugin` Installed tab: you can now type spaces in a search query, press `Enter` to finish searching, then use `Space` to toggle the selected plugin and `Enter` to expand its details; start typing again to resume the search.

Fixed an expired or revoked sign-in showing an unclear error mid-session; the agent now says `Authentication expired. Please log back in.`, and a token refresh that was already in flight no longer restores the expired credentials.
Fixed `/add-dir` claiming it added a path that doesn't exist or isn't a directory; it now reports `directory not found` or `not a directory`.
Fixed `/btw` side questions running your user and workspace hooks, which could make hooks such as stop hooks loop or add extra steps to a quick question.
Fixed Jujutsu (`jj`) commands run by the agent, such as `jj diff` or `jj log`, hanging in an interactive pager; agent commands now set `JJ_PAGER=cat` alongside `PAGER` and `GIT_PAGER`.
Fixed subagents started with a `branch` or `share` workspace in a multi-repository workspace silently working in your real checkout; each repository now gets its own isolated copy.
Fixed a stopped subagent staying in the active agents list while it still had an approval pending; stopping it now clears its pending approvals right away.

Fixed `--remote-control` failing when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`); Remote Control doesn't support ADC yet, so the flag now exits with a clear error and the `/remote-control` command is hidden.
Fixed custom `alt` keybindings such as `alt+s` not working with the macOS Option key in terminals that don't treat Option as Meta, such as Terminal.app and VS Code-based terminals.
Fixed `/keybindings` silently doing nothing when the configured editor can't be found; it now shows an error.

Fixed `agy plugin validate` and plugin listings missing skills declared through the `skills` field in `plugin.json` or ignoring `skills.json` exclusions, so they now match the skills that actually load, and fixed a race that could drop results when importing plugins.
Fixed sandboxed commands failing with `Access is denied.` on Windows when PowerShell 7 was installed from the Microsoft Store; the agent now falls back to Windows PowerShell in that case.
Fixed `/diff` showing the error from `git diff HEAD` instead of the real cause, such as a corrupt index, when the fallback `git diff` also fails.
Fixed file links in agent responses whose line anchor was percent-encoded, such as `file.go%23L795`; the label now shows the line number and the link opens the correct line.
Fixed separate links to the same URL highlighting together when you hover over one of them in terminals that support clickable links.

Fixed counts in tool steps and the `/codesearch` panel, which now read "Found 1 result", "1 match", "1 file", and "Wrote 1 line" instead of "1 results", and the file-creation step reporting one line too many.

title.zh-TW: 回看長對話提示詞常駐置頂，點擊即跳回提問處
title.en: Sticky Prompt Keeps Context Visible During Deep Scrollbacks, Clicking Jumps to Origin

body.zh-TW: 在長篇對話裡向上捲動翻查舊紀錄，很容易讀著讀著就忘記眼前這段回答最初是在回應哪一道問題。現在處於無閃爍模式時，產生你正在閱讀的這則回覆的提示詞，會直接常駐在視窗頂部。⟦如同大型會議室白板最上方的題目標籤，以前往下滑動紀錄就看不見當初的問題，現在不管對話拉得多長，那道提問始終固定在視窗頂端，想對照時點一下就能瞬間回到原處。⟧翻閱冗長的分析報告時更能隨時掌握脈絡，點擊該標頭還能立刻跳轉回最初提問的位置。
body.en: When scrolling up through long conversations to review past messages, it is easy to lose track of which prompt initiated the answer you are reading. In flicker-free mode, the prompt that generated the reply you are currently viewing now remains pinned to the top of the window. ⟦Like a topic banner fixed to the top of a conference whiteboard, where scrolling down previously hid the original question, the prompt now stays anchored at the top of the screen no matter how far the thread stretches, letting you jump back instantly with a single click.⟧ This preserves context when skimming lengthy analysis reports, and clicking the header takes you straight back to the original question.

items.original: Added a pinned prompt header in no flickering mode while you scroll back through a long conversation: the prompt that produced the response you're reading stays at the top of the transcript, and clicking it jumps back to that prompt.

title.zh-TW: 外接工具支援常駐載入，免去隨需探索的等待
title.en: Always-Loaded Tools Eliminate On-Demand Discovery Latency

body.zh-TW:
串接大量常用工具後，若每次發問都得等 AI 重新檢視清單才能上工，對話節奏難免被打斷。⟦好比木匠把最常用的捲尺直接插在工作圍裙口袋，以前每接一項委託都要跑回工具庫翻找盤點，現在一開工就能直接抽出使用。⟧現在 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器能將高頻率使用的工具標記為常駐載入。只要在 `tools/list` 回覆的工具資料裡加入以下設定：
```json
{"_meta": {"antigravity/alwaysLoad": true}}
```
代理就能直接取得該項工具，不再需要於執行過程中臨時隨需探索。
body.en:
After connecting many frequently used tools, waiting for the AI to re-inspect the catalog before every query breaks the conversational flow. ⟦Think of a carpenter who keeps a tape measure right in an apron pocket, reaching for it instantly instead of walking back to rummage through the tool chest for every assignment.⟧ MCP servers can now mark high-frequency tools to be loaded permanently. By adding the following metadata to the tool payload in `tools/list` responses:
```json
{"_meta": {"antigravity/alwaysLoad": true}}
```
The agent receives the tool immediately, eliminating runtime on-demand discovery.

items.original: Added support for MCP servers to mark a tool as always loaded by setting `_meta: {"antigravity/alwaysLoad": true}` on it in their `tools/list` response, so the agent gets that tool directly instead of discovering it on demand.

title.zh-TW: macOS 沙盒預設鎖定應用程式支援目錄，杜絕密鑰外洩
title.en: macOS Sandbox Blocks Application Support Directory by Default to Prevent Key Leaks

body.zh-TW: 放手讓自動化指令在沙盒裡執行，許多人最在意的就是其他應用程式儲存的私密憑證會不會被看光。⟦彷彿給到府清潔工限制活動區域，以前對方能隨意翻動臥室梳妝台上的皮夾，現在預設只能在客廳打掃，不再碰得到你收在抽屜裡的私密證件。⟧macOS 上的桌面應用程式習慣將登入憑證與工作階段 token（授權令牌）存放在 `~/Library/Application Support` 目錄下。以前沙盒內的指令預設可以直接讀取該路徑，現在預設直接阻擋這項權限。如果你的特定腳本確實需要取用裡面的設定檔，依然可以在沙盒規則中明確手動放行。
body.en: When allowing automated commands to run inside a sandbox, a primary concern is whether private credentials stored by other applications might be exposed. ⟦Picture restricting a home cleaner to specific rooms, cleaning only the living room by default rather than looking through a wallet left on the bedroom dresser, keeping private identification tucked away in drawers out of reach.⟧ Desktop applications on macOS typically store login credentials and session tokens in `~/Library/Application Support`. Sandboxed commands previously had read access to that path by default, but this access is now blocked. If a specific script genuinely requires access to configuration files in that path, you can still grant permission explicitly in sandbox rules.

items.original: Changed the macOS terminal sandbox to block sandboxed commands from reading `~/Library/Application Support` by default, since desktop apps keep credentials and session tokens there; previously it was readable, and you can still allow it explicitly in your sandbox rules.

title.zh-TW: 外掛支援宣告子代理，管理介面搜尋與驗證更順手
title.en: Plugins Support Declaring Subagents, Management Interface Improves Search and Validation

body.zh-TW: 為團隊量身製作外掛時，往往需要同時打包專屬的子代理、技能設定與運作規則。現在外掛根目錄支援建立 `agents.json`，讓作者能像以往用 `skills.json` 和 `rules.json` 宣告技能與規則那樣，直接宣告專屬的子代理。在 `/plugin` 指令的「已安裝」分頁中，搜尋體驗也更加順手。你現在能在搜尋關鍵字裡輸入空格，按下 `Enter` 結束搜尋後，用 `Space` 空白鍵即可切換啟用選取的外掛，按 `Enter` 展開查看詳細資訊，直接再次打字便能繼續搜尋。執行 `agy plugin validate` 驗證與瀏覽清單時，以前容易漏掉在 `plugin.json` 裡透過 `skills` 欄位宣告的技能，或者忽略了 `skills.json` 的排除項目；現在這些顯示已與實際載入的技能完全一致，同時修復了匯入外掛時可能遺失結果的競爭問題。
body.en: Tailoring a plugin for a team often requires packaging dedicated subagents, skills, and operational rules together. Plugins now support an `agents.json` file in their root directory, enabling authors to declare subagents directly, just as they declare skills and rules via `skills.json` and `rules.json`. In the Installed tab of the `/plugin` command, searching is also more intuitive. You can now include spaces in search queries, press `Enter` to finish searching, toggle the selected plugin with `Space`, press `Enter` to expand details, or type again to continue searching. When running `agy plugin validate` to verify and inspect the list, skills declared through the `skills` field in `plugin.json` or excluded in `skills.json` were previously sometimes overlooked; the validation display now matches loaded skills, and a race condition that could drop imported plugin results has been fixed.

items.original:
Added support for a root-level `agents.json` in plugins, so a plugin can declare its subagents the same way it declares skills and rules with `skills.json` and `rules.json`.
Improved search in the `/plugin` Installed tab: you can now type spaces in a search query, press `Enter` to finish searching, then use `Space` to toggle the selected plugin and `Enter` to expand its details; start typing again to resume the search.
Fixed `agy plugin validate` and plugin listings missing skills declared through the `skills` field in `plugin.json` or ignoring `skills.json` exclusions, so they now match the skills that actually load, and fixed a race that could drop results when importing plugins.

title.zh-TW: 子代理工作區落實獨立隔離，停止時即刻清理待審批
title.en: Subagent Workspaces Enforce Full Isolation, Stopping Clears Pending Approvals Promptly

body.zh-TW: 背景子代理在多個專案同時動工，一旦動到你目前正在編輯的原始檔案，後續排查將會苦不堪言。⟦正如把工程圖紙影印給外包助理各自標記，以前助理可能直接在你的原稿上塗改，現在每組人都拿到獨立的工作影本，各自施工互不干擾。⟧在包含多個版本庫的工作區中，以往用 `branch` 或 `share` 工作區模式啟動的子代理，會在背後悄悄動用你的真實簽出目錄；現在這項問題已經修正，每個版本庫都會獲得專屬的隔離複本。當你手動停止子代理時，以前若對方還有未完成的審批請求，該代理會一直留在活躍清單裡；現在只要一下令停止，所有等待審批的事項都會立即清空，代理名單也不再殘留。
body.en: When background subagents operate across multiple projects, modifying files you are currently editing makes troubleshooting difficult. ⟦A team lead hands distinct photocopies of blueprints to contractor assistants, ensuring each team marks up an independent working copy without altering the master drawing.⟧ In workspaces with multiple repositories, subagents launched in `branch` or `share` workspace mode previously operated against your actual checkout directories behind the scenes; this is now fixed, giving each repository its own isolated copy. When you stop a subagent manually, unresolved approval requests previously kept it lingering in the active list; issuing a stop command now clears all pending approvals immediately, cleanly removing the subagent.

items.original:
Fixed subagents started with a `branch` or `share` workspace in a multi-repository workspace silently working in your real checkout; each repository now gets its own isolated copy.
Fixed a stopped subagent staying in the active agents list while it still had an approval pending; stopping it now clears its pending approvals right away.

title.zh-TW: 斜線指令異常回報精準化，順口提問不再觸發掛鉤
title.en: Slash Commands Sharpen Error Reporting, Incidental Queries Avoid Triggering Hooks

body.zh-TW: 敲下斜線指令卻敲錯目錄路徑，如果工具悶不吭聲假裝成功，很容易讓人誤判環境現況。執行 `/add-dir` 加入目錄時，以前就算輸入了根本不存在的路徑或一般檔案，工具依然會宣稱新增成功；現在它會老實回報 `directory not found` 或 `not a directory`。利用 `/btw` 順口插話詢問旁支問題時，以前會誤跑你的使用者與工作區 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），導致停止掛鉤陷入迴圈或讓簡單提問多出額外步驟，這項問題如今已被修正。輸入 `/keybindings` 查看快捷鍵時，若找不到設定的編輯器，不再毫無反應地靜默跳過，而是會主動顯示錯誤。當 `/diff` 備援（fallback）的 `git diff` 也執行失敗時，現在會顯示索引損壞等真實肇因，不再誤報成 `git diff HEAD` 的錯誤訊息。
body.en: When entering a slash command with an invalid directory path, a silent mock success can lead to incorrect assumptions about the environment. When running `/add-dir`, entering a nonexistent path or a regular file previously reported success anyway; it now explicitly returns `directory not found` or `not a directory`. Asking side questions with `/btw` previously triggered user and workspace hooks, causing stop hooks to loop or adding unnecessary overhead to simple inquiries, an issue that is now resolved. Running `/keybindings` to view keyboard shortcuts now displays an error if the configured editor cannot be located instead of failing silently. When the `git diff` fallback for `/diff` fails, it now displays the actual underlying cause, such as index corruption, instead of misreporting an error with `git diff HEAD`.

items.original:
Fixed `/add-dir` claiming it added a path that doesn't exist or isn't a directory; it now reports `directory not found` or `not a directory`.
Fixed `/btw` side questions running your user and workspace hooks, which could make hooks such as stop hooks loop or add extra steps to a quick question.
Fixed `/keybindings` silently doing nothing when the configured editor can't be found; it now shows an error.
Fixed `/diff` showing the error from `git diff HEAD` instead of the real cause, such as a corrupt index, when the fallback `git diff` also fails.

title.zh-TW: 連線與認證錯誤顯示更明確，用盡額度不再盲目重試
title.en: Connection and Authentication Errors Surface Clearer Details, Exhausted Quotas Halt Retries

body.zh-TW: 遇到企業代理伺服器阻擋時，主控台若被整段 HTML 原始碼淹沒，很難第一時間掌握原因。現在遇到這類錯誤頁面只會顯示網頁標題，其他過長的非 JSON 錯誤內容也會在 500 個位元組處截斷。個人配額（quota，使用額度）用盡時會立刻回報，不再反覆重試。工作階段中若登入憑證過期或被撤銷，現在會明確提示 `Authentication expired. Please log back in.`，且背景中正在傳輸的權杖更新也不會還原失效憑證。使用 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 應用程式預設憑證登入時，因遠端控制尚未支援，加上 `--remote-control` 參數會清楚退出並說明原因，選單中的 `/remote-control` 指令也會自動隱藏。
body.en: When an enterprise proxy blocks requests, drowning the console in raw HTML makes identifying the cause difficult. Error pages now display only the page title, and other excessively long non-JSON error bodies are truncated at 500 bytes. When personal quota is exhausted, the system reports it immediately instead of retrying repeatedly. If login credentials expire or are revoked during a session, the system now provides an explicit `Authentication expired. Please log back in.` notice, and background token refresh transmissions will not restore invalid credentials. Because remote control is not supported when authenticating with `AGY_ADC_AUTH` application default credentials, passing `--remote-control` now exits cleanly with an explanation, and `/remote-control` is automatically hidden from menus.

items.original:
Improved error messages: a request that fails with an HTML error page, for example from a corporate proxy, now shows the page title instead of the raw HTML, other long non-JSON error bodies are cut off after 500 bytes, and reaching your individual quota is reported right away instead of being retried.
Fixed an expired or revoked sign-in showing an unclear error mid-session; the agent now says `Authentication expired. Please log back in.`, and a token refresh that was already in flight no longer restores the expired credentials.
Fixed `--remote-control` failing when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`); Remote Control doesn't support ADC yet, so the flag now exits with a clear error and the `/remote-control` command is hidden.

title.zh-TW: 終端機分頁卡死問題修復，快捷鍵與跨系統執行更穩定
title.en: Terminal Pager Hangs Resolved, Shortcut Keys and Cross-Platform Runs Gain Stability

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡執行版本控制或自訂按鍵，跨平台環境的細微落差常會導致畫面莫名卡死。代理執行 Jujutsu 的 `jj diff` 或 `jj log` 等指令時，以往容易卡在互動式分頁器；現在指令會自動帶上 `JJ_PAGER=cat`，與既有的 `PAGER` 和 `GIT_PAGER` 並列輸出。在 macOS 的 Terminal.app 或 VS Code 終端機裡，因系統未將 Option 視為 Meta 鍵而導致 `alt+s` 等自訂快捷鍵失效的問題現已修正。在 Windows 上若從微軟商店安裝 PowerShell 7，沙盒指令過去會跳出 `Access is denied.`，現在會自動備援切回 Windows PowerShell 順利執行。
body.en: Running version control commands or custom key combinations in the terminal can freeze unexpectedly due to subtle cross-platform differences. When the agent ran Jujutsu commands like `jj diff` or `jj log`, it often hung on interactive pagers; commands now pass `JJ_PAGER=cat` automatically, matching existing handling for `PAGER` and `GIT_PAGER`. In macOS Terminal.app and VS Code terminals, custom shortcuts such as `alt+s` failing because the system did not treat Option as a Meta key have been resolved. On Windows, sandboxed commands executed with PowerShell 7 installed from the Microsoft Store previously encountered `Access is denied.`; execution now automatically falls back to Windows PowerShell.

items.original:
Fixed Jujutsu (`jj`) commands run by the agent, such as `jj diff` or `jj log`, hanging in an interactive pager; agent commands now set `JJ_PAGER=cat` alongside `PAGER` and `GIT_PAGER`.
Fixed custom `alt` keybindings such as `alt+s` not working with the macOS Option key in terminals that don't treat Option as Meta, such as Terminal.app and VS Code-based terminals.
Fixed sandboxed commands failing with `Access is denied.` on Windows when PowerShell 7 was installed from the Microsoft Store; the agent now falls back to Windows PowerShell in that case.

title.zh-TW: 終端機連結跳轉更精準，步驟與程式碼搜尋計數不再失真
title.en: Terminal Links Jump Accurately, Step and Code Search Counts Correct Singular Forms

body.zh-TW: 對話記錄裡的檔案路徑若能精確對應程式碼行號，點擊除錯的過程就會省下許多來回對照的功夫。回覆文字中的檔案連結如果帶有百分比編碼的行號錨點，例如 `file.go%23L795`，以前標籤常顯示不正常。現在標籤會清楚顯示行號，點擊後也能精準開啟並跳至指定行數。在支援可點擊連結的終端機裡，若畫面上有多個指向相同網址的獨立連結，以往滑鼠懸停在其中一個上面時會導致全部連結一起被突顯反白，如今各個連結已能獨立反應。工具執行步驟與 `/codesearch` 面板上的英文單數計數也完成了校正，單一項目會正確顯示為 Found 1 result、1 match、1 file 與 Wrote 1 line，不再出現複數結尾的贅字，同時修正了建立檔案步驟中行數多報一行的問題。
body.en: When file paths in conversation transcripts point accurately to code line numbers, clicking to debug saves considerable manual cross-referencing. In response text, file links with percent-encoded line number anchors, such as `file.go%23L795`, previously failed to render their labels correctly. Labels now display line numbers clearly, and clicking them opens and navigates directly to the specified line. In terminals that support clickable links, hovering over one of several independent links pointing to the same URL previously highlighted all of them; links now react independently. Tool execution steps and the `/codesearch` panel have also corrected English singular counts, properly showing Found 1 result, 1 match, 1 file, and Wrote 1 line without plural suffixes, while fixing an issue where file creation steps overreported line counts by one.

items.original:
Fixed file links in agent responses whose line anchor was percent-encoded, such as `file.go%23L795`; the label now shows the line number and the link opens the correct line.
Fixed separate links to the same URL highlighting together when you hover over one of them in terminals that support clickable links.
Fixed counts in tool steps and the `/codesearch` panel, which now read "Found 1 result", "1 match", "1 file", and "Wrote 1 line" instead of "1 results", and the file-creation step reporting one line too many.

entries: Added `/plugin`, an interactive manager for the official Antigravity plugin marketplace: browse and install plugins that bundle skills, MCP servers, subagents, rules, and hooks, or install them from your shell without opening the CLI with `agy plugin install <plugin-name>@antigravity-plugins-official`; install one straight from a folder on your computer with `+ Install from local directory...`; fill in any settings a plugin needs in a simple form before it turns on; and manage installed plugins with `/plugin install`, `uninstall`, `enable`, `disable`, and `list`.

Added more options for plugin authors: keep the manifest in a `.antigravity-plugin/` or `.gemini-plugin/` folder, list skills in `plugin.json`, store data in a per-plugin folder available as `PLUGIN_DATA`, and ship command-line tools in a `bin/` folder that the agent can run by name.
Improved plugin installs: the plugin list opens instantly, an interrupted install never leaves a half-installed plugin behind, and installing or removing plugins on Windows is more reliable.

Improved plugin compatibility: plugins load every skill in their `skills/` folder, remote MCP servers start correctly once their settings are filled in, and a plugin's subagents can use the plugin's own MCP servers.

Changed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` to stop auto-approving the agent's implementation plan in `/plan` mode: the flag now only skips tool permission prompts, so plans wait for your review again. Set `Artifact Review` in `/config` if you want plans and other artifacts to proceed automatically.
Improved CPU usage while the agent runs long shell commands with a lot of output, since output that is already valid UTF-8 is no longer rescanned in full on every update.
